long_biography.plain_text:
Siberian Cement was the industrial platform through which Muravyov first became widely known in business. After work in finance and management, he helped establish the group and served as its chief executive for four years. Company history credits that period with assembling the producer's core operating base and developing a national sales system.

Parus Capital became his platform for diversifying beyond construction materials. He also held a QIWI board seat and equity interest, while other portfolio activity extended into farming, food production, industrial recycling and real estate. He combined operating-company creation with capital allocation across technology, agriculture and industrial assets.
